input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 (p0044) expressly preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to engage any supplier, and records that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment. No clause anywhere imposes a sole-supplier, all-requirements, or no-third-party-procurement obligation on us, so the rule sits at the preferred position. Section 7.2 (p0026) is a disclose-and-match / most-favoured-offer mechanic and does not prohibit engaging another provider once honoured, so it is handled under MFN, not exclusivity. Section 2.1 (p0012) is a take-or-pay minimum-volume commitment (and Section 12.4's competing-product covenant a non-compete); those are minimum-commitment and restrictive-covenant issues for their own rules and are not sourcing exclusivity, so we do not flag them twice here.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
